title: Caddy
comment: Caddy's state is the Caddyfile plus its XDG storage: data/ (ACME account and certificates -- carrying it avoids re-issuance and rate limits) and config/ (autosave.json). The FreeBSD rc script sets XDG under caddy_directory (default /var/db/caddy) with the Caddyfile at /usr/local/etc/caddy/Caddyfile and runs as root; the official Linux image uses /etc/caddy/Caddyfile, /data and /config; the Daemonless image sets XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/config (Caddyfile beside it) and XDG_DATA_HOME=/data. Site roots and log paths inside the carried Caddyfile name source locations and need editing. Multi-volume recipe (the internal development record); every source location is a named path because the two sources do not share one root.

drop: ACME certificates and keys in the data volume: Caddy issues them again on the Linux host
site roots and log files (paths inside the Caddyfile need editing)
